benefit_text: The scheme brings one member, preferably a woman, from each rural poor household into a Self Help Group network. Women SHGs get bank linkage, capacity building, livelihood promotion and financial inclusion. Revolving funds and interest subvention support SHG credit.
who_can_apply: Self Help Groups that have been active for at least six months and follow regular meetings, savings, inter‑loaning, timely repayment and up‑to‑date accounts are eligible. Groups graded by NABARD standards qualify. Defunct groups can join after reviving for three months.
documents: Aadhar number, proof of identity, proof of residence, voter ID card, passport size photo are required.
how_to_apply: Visit the DAY‑NRLM registration portal online. Fill mandatory fields such as name, email and contact number. Provide a username, create and confirm a password, then click Create New Account.
